reference_sql:
SELECT a.spend_date, a.spend,
  a.spend - LAG(a.spend) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date) AS change_eur
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Search | email marketing software | 2025'
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'
alternatives:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, a.spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Search | email marketing software | 2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'
), paired AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT d.spend_date, d.spend, (SELECT MAX(p.spend_date) FROM days p WHERE p.spend_date < d.spend_date) AS prev_date
  FROM days d
)
SELECT x.spend_date, x.spend, x.spend - y.spend AS change_eur
FROM paired x
LEFT JOIN days y ON y.spend_date = x.prev_date

  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'

WITH days AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, a.spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Search | email marketing software | 2025'
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-07-31'
), paired AS (
  -- one row per day with spend
  SELECT d.spend_date, d.spend, (SELECT MAX(p.spend_date) FROM days p WHERE p.spend_date < d.spend_date) AS prev_date
  FROM days d
)
SELECT x.spend_date, x.spend, x.spend - y.spend AS change_eur
FROM paired x
LEFT JOIN days y ON y.spend_date = x.prev_date
other_way.tradeoff: Pairing each day with the latest earlier day through a subquery and a join works anywhere, but takes three steps where LAG takes one.
